items.title: Setback for AAP ahead of Punjab elections; 3 MLAs join the BJP
items.summary: Digital Desk, Chandigarh. The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) has suffered a major blow ahead of the Punjab Assembly elections. Three MLAs have left the party over the last two days, with the rebel legislators joining the BJP on Monday. On Monday, rebel AAP leaders Kunwar Vijay Pratap Singh, Harmeet Singh Pathanmajra, and Chetan Singh Jouramajra joined the BJP in Delhi.
